privacyCommitment.message: Your privacy is our priority, and we give you complete control over your data. Your rules and settings are stored securely and exclusively locally on your device using chrome.storage. We guarantee that the extension does not collect, store, or transmit your browsing history or any personal information. For your convenience, if you have Chrome sync enabled, Google can securely back up these settings to your account, allowing you to have a consistent experience across all your devices. This process is optional and managed by Google, ensuring your control at all times.

📊 Session Efficiency

• Deep green (≥80%): Excellent session — almost all time was pure focus.
• Medium green (60-79%): Good session, breaks within expected range.
• Yellow (40-59%): Room to improve — breaks are outweighing focus.
• Red (<40%): Many interruptions or overly long breaks.

Formula: (Focus time ÷ Total time) × 100
Total time includes focus + breaks + interruptions.
